entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 details five core DMZ features
entries.summary: Drawing on the official Call of Duty blog, Xbox Wire outlines DMZ: the open map Hajin features looting, missions, combat against players and AI, and extraction. Digital preorder customers can access DMZ early on October 20.

entries.headline: The Escapists 3 announced for four platforms in 2027
entries.summary: Team17 announced prison-escape sandbox sequel The Escapists 3 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. The new game switches to 3D graphics, includes five prisons and supports two-player local and four-player online co-op.
entries.verification: Two independent media sources were opened and agree on the subject and core facts.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE surpasses one million sales worldwide
entries.summary: The official ACE COMBAT account announced that ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE has sold more than one million copies worldwide since its October 2 release, calling it the fastest game in the series to reach that milestone.
